itemUsage.en: A woman who grew up in the midst of disorder, with hopes of seeking a new direction here.
itemUsage.zh: 一个在混乱之中长大的人，期望能在这里寻找到新的方向。

itemDesc.en: If the past is beyond change, then she will turn to decide her own future.
itemDesc.zh: 如果过去已经无法改变，那么她将决定自己的未来。

description.en:
Operator Cantabile has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude in repeated battlefield penetration and establishing advantageous situations for allies in the field.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Vanguard Operator during field operations to exercise Agent responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员晓歌擅长反复切入战场并为我方建立优势
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为先锋干员，行使情报官职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en:
Cantabile places the leather case she is carrying on the desk. This is the fifteenth time she has opened it since submitting her report to Rhodes Island. A fowlbeast curls up as it dozes on the corner of the desk, the miniature mountain of grains it piled up still by her hand.
'Number 01. First used in Dossoles. Target: the Ramirez couple... Husband and wife, both major founders of the Sacred Heart Welfare Foundation. Residence entered under the guise of a tutor. 8 hours, 22 minutes over schedule. Punishment was fasting for 25 hours.'
Cantabile senses her vocal cords quivering as she wipes the knife with a cloth.
'Number 02. First used in Dossoles. Target: 'Greenbeard', a representative of a local worker's federation. Participated in a union theater performance under the guise of a student. 2 hours, 10 minutes over schedule. Punishment was confinement for 6 hours.'
She cleans her weapons, over and over, summarizing her past missions as she does so. A habit etched into her by the sickening training she received during her days in darkness. She is unsure when it became the only way she can destress. She wants to change, but they followed her close.
'Number 03. First used in southern Bolívar. Target: Miguel Luis, police captain. Approached the target under the guise of a restaurant band member. Completed on schedule.
'Number 04. First used in southern Bolívar. Target: Luchi Luis, newspaper journalist. Residence entered under the guise of a new poet. During a poetry recital, the contents of Number 04 were dumped into his wine glass. Completed on schedule.
'...Yes, I got better at them as I went. I recited poetry, played instruments, even learned how to sing... I learned that all so that... so that those beautiful notes would conceal the sound of my footsteps as I approached...'
The Liberi woman loosens her vice grip. She closes her eyes. The awakened fowlbeast looks at her in puzzlement, its head askew.
'Number 05.' The longest of them, the broadest of them, the hardest of them to conceal. She has never forgotten its position. 'First used in Bunkerhill, Columbia. Target: the traitor 'Gold'. Hunt them down and strike fast. Make it painless...'
She retches. The knives lie there in their case, in voiceless silence.
Of course. They're dismantled now. They once lived in poem and song. They were always silent.
How would these kindhearted people look upon her? How would these saviors of men look upon a killer? How would the triplets in andante look upon a monstrous, bloodstained knife quivering point-down in the wood grain?
'Coo—coocoo—!'
The sound of the fowlbeast's flapping wings and melodic chirps mingle by her ear. She opens her eyes. It has thrown that familiar golden pendent into the case, scattering the neatly-arranged cold congregation. The little golden spot lets out a bright warmth on its own.
From the other side of the door, the gentle voice of a field operator is punctuated by a few raps on the door.
'Are you awake, Cantabile? I, err, if you'd like to talk about things... How about we go get something to eat at the cafeteria?'
description.zh:
晓歌将随身携带的皮匣放置在桌面上，这是她向罗德岛提交报告后第十五次打开它。羽兽缩在桌角打盹，它堆起的米粒小山仍在晓歌手边。
“编号01。首次使用于多索雷斯。目标，拉米雷斯……夫妇，圣心福利基金会的主要发起人。以家庭教师身份进入宅邸。超时8小时22分钟。处罚方案，禁食25小时。”
绒布摩擦着刀锋，晓歌感受着自己声带的颤抖。
“编号02。首次使用于多索雷斯。目标，‘绿胡子’，当地工人联合会代表。以学生身份参与工会文艺演出。超时2小时10分钟。处罚方案，禁闭6小时。”
反复清洁武器，总结任务完成情况。那段不见天日、令人作呕的训练给她留下的习惯，不知什么时候已经成为她解压的唯一方式。她已经决意改变，可它们还在追着她。
“编号03。首次使用于玻利瓦尔南部，目标，米格尔·路易斯，警署署长。以餐厅乐队成员身份接近目标。未超时。
“编号04。首次使用于玻利瓦尔南部，目标，路易·路易斯，报社撰稿人。以新晋诗人身份进入宅邸，在诗歌朗诵会上将编号04内容物投入酒杯。未超时。
“……是的，我做得越来越好了。我朗诵诗歌，我演奏乐器，我甚至学习歌唱……这一切都只是为了，为了让那些美妙的声响，掩盖我接近目标的脚步声……”
黎博利姑娘的手紧握又松开。她闭上眼睛。苏醒的羽兽疑惑地歪着脑袋看向她。
“编号05。”最长、最宽、最难以掩藏，她永远记得它的位置。“首次使用于哥伦比亚堡垒山城，目标，背叛者‘金’。追击，尽可能快，不要造成痛苦……”
干呕声自她喉咙深处溢出来。刀刃们躺在匣中，无声无响。
是的，它们如今已被拆下，它们曾住在乐曲与诗歌里。它们从来都是沉默的。
那些善良的人要如何看她？救人的人要如何看一个杀人的人？行板上的三连音要如何看一柄卡在木纹中的，狰狞而沾血的刀？
“啾——啾啾啾——！”
耳边，羽兽振翅的声响与清脆的鸣叫交织，她睁开眼，看见羽兽将那枚熟悉的金色挂坠投入匣中，碰散了那整齐排列的无声者们，独自开辟出一点亮闪闪的暖色。
门的另一侧，外勤干员温和的声音随着敲门声一起传来。
“晓歌，你醒着吗？那个，如果你愿意的话……今天要不要和我一起去食堂吃饭？”
